objective: Proposed starter subset of storytold/lightcraft#3479: let a person keep the English interface and explicitly choose 24-hour capture-time display through ui.json, independently of language. Preserve current presentation when the preference is absent. The proposed implementation target is nkovanen/lightcraft only; execution is not yet authorized.

behavior_criteria.description: A documented persisted UI preference can select 24-hour capture-time display while language remains English; for example a valid 22:11:11 capture time displays 22:11:11 without PM, while English labels remain English.
Existing ui.json files without the new preference retain the current language-dependent display. The preference survives a UiState serialize/deserialize round trip.
Both the right Info panel and detail photo information use the selected presentation; midnight, noon, date-only values and malformed/non-ASCII input are covered without adding a panic path.
The preference changes presentation only: capture metadata, stored timestamps, sorting/group keys, catalog data and exports remain unchanged.
docs/localization.md documents the exact ui.json key and supported values; affected parity/gap descriptions and release notes accurately state that this is only the time-format starter subset.
